Implementation and rule: - File: src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - Header explicitly ties to this story and its requirements: - @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md - @req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION - @req REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION - @req REQ-PATH-FORMAT - @req REQ-REQ-FORMAT - @req REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT - @req REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING - @req REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY - Core behavior and mapping to requirements: - REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION / REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION: - The rule inspects all comments in Program via sourceCode.getAllComments() and processComment, which parses lines, detects @story/@req tags, and delegates to validateStoryAnnotation / validateReqAnnotation. - REQ-PATH-FORMAT: - validateStoryAnnotation enforces story paths to match regex: - /^docs\/stories\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-DEV-[\w-]+\.story\.md$/ - Rejects paths with traversal (getFixedStoryPath returns null if original.includes("..")), so paths like "../docs/stories/..." are considered invalid. - REQ-REQ-FORMAT: - validateReqAnnotation enforces identifiers with regex: - /^REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+$/ - Distinguishes missing vs invalid IDs and reports via invalidReqFormat. - REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT: - collapseAnnotationValue replaces all whitespace with no spaces, allowing multi-line annotation values to be validated as a single logical value. - processComment tracks a PendingAnnotation and accumulates continuation lines for a tag until another tag or end of comment, then finalizes and validates. - REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING: - normalizeCommentLine handles common JSDoc styles, trimming whitespace and removing leading "*" when no @story/@req tag is present at the start, making parsing resilient to formatting. - REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY: - buildStoryErrorMessage and buildReqErrorMessage construct precise messages: - Missing vs invalid values are distinguished. - Messages include example path "docs/stories/005.0-DEV-EXAMPLE.story.md" or ID "REQ-EXAMPLE". - Rule meta.messages: - invalidStoryFormat: "Invalid annotation format: {{details}}." - invalidReqFormat: "Invalid annotation format: {{details}}." - The details field is populated with the specific, human-readable error message, fulfilling clear, specific error messaging. - Integration: - The rule’s Program visitor runs independently of specific function/branch rules and inspects all comments in the file. Any annotations used by src/rules/require-story-annotation.ts, src/rules/require-req-annotation.ts, and branch helpers will also be validated for format and syntax.

traceability.notes: The story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION is fully implemented. The dedicated ESLint rule valid-annotation-format enforces syntax and format of @story and @req annotations, covering path structure, REQ-* identifier patterns, multi-line annotations, flexible comment formatting, and specific, actionable error messages. It integrates by scanning all comments in a file, so annotations detected by function and branch rules are also validated. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly reference this story and its requirements and comprehensively verify both valid and invalid annotation patterns that match the story’s examples. The project’s Jest test suite runs without reported failures using the configured npm test script. Therefore, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
